subject: Vendor setup kickoff — Aurelia Biomed (buyer intake & bank/tax info)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup kickoff — Aurelia Biomed (buyer intake & bank/tax info)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. I’m kicking off the vendor setup with our procurement team so we can get Aurelia added to Redwood’s vendor registry and issue POs once the SOW is signed. To keep the vendor-side work scoped and fast, can you please provide the items below by end of day Wednesday, May 19?

Needed from Aurelia Biomed (minimum to create vendor record / enable ACH):
- Legal Entity name (exact as registered)
- Registered address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or VAT id if non-US)
- Remit-to address (if different from registered address)
- Preferred payment method: ACH or Wire (if ACH, we need bank details; if wire, bank SWIFT/IBAN)
- ACH authorization: bank letter on company letterhead or a copy of a voided check / bank statement showing company name and last 4 digits
- Completed W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone) for PO/invoice routes

If you’d rather fill a short buyer intake form we use internally, here’s a quick form (takes ~6 min):
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1BuyerIntakeExample

Attachments: we prefer files named with company and doc type (e.g., Aurelia_W9.pdf). If you have any vendor setup templates from your side, include them and we’ll map fields.

Operational notes:
- Standard payment terms for initial onboarding are Net 45 unless a different term is mutually agreed and added to the PO.
- Redwood requires the remit-to name to match the bank account name for ACH setup; if that differs, please include an explanation and supporting bank letter.

Next steps: once we receive the docs above our procurement team (cc’d) will create the vendor record, run the internal tax & entity checks, and open the first PO. Expect a short follow-up if any fields don’t match.

Thanks — appreciate your help getting this across the finish line.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup kickoff — Aurelia Biomed (buyer intake & bank/tax info)

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the prompt reply and the attachments. Quick clarifications before we create the vendor record:

1) The bank stub shows account ending 1234 and the company name, which is good. For ACH we prefer a bank letter on letterhead that explicitly authorizes ACH payments to the account (this is a one-time request for our treasury team). If you can provide that, it speeds review.

2) Our tax team flagged the EIN format as fine, but we need the company registration number (state file #) or copy of the articles of incorporation for compliance records — can you provide either?

3) Regarding payment terms: Procurement typically issues standard PO terms of Net 45 for new suppliers while we complete financial onboarding. If Aurelia requires Net 30 as a contract term, we can escalate to Finance for approval; can you confirm if Net 30 is required for you or just preferred?

Action items (for Aurelia):
- Upload bank letter on letterhead OR a voided company check (PDF)
- Provide company registration number or articles of incorporation
- Confirm whether you want Net 30 as a contractual payment term (we’ll route the request if yes)

I’m copying Marissa to keep finance/procurement ops in the loop. Once we have the bank letter and registration docs we’ll mark the record as approved and generate the first PO.

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Thanks for the materials and for answering the initial questions. We’ve started the internal checks; two quick operational notes: 

• SLA/Timeline: Typical onboarding is 5–7 business days after we receive the bank letter and registration docs. If Finance needs to review NET30, that can add 2–3 business days for approval.
• PO issuance: Procurement will create the PO once the vendor record is approved. Please confirm the billing email for PO/invoice receipt (if different from olivia.harper@aureliabiomed.com).
